reviews.text: Dr Ainsley and staff were very attentive and caring.  I appreciate the several call backs to get me updates about her surgery.  I will recommend.

Today my husband and i lost my baby girl Midnight. She was going through a tough time these past 3 weeks and I just wanted to take the time to appreciate Dr. Estes and the team here at this location. Never would I have imagined I'd lose my baby girl. But the thoughtfulness and treatments this team had with her has made this process a little better for my husband and I. I truly appreciate the care and love they gave Midnight. 100/10 would have this team take care of your babies as they do for mine.
Dr Estes and his assistant Evan are great. They both are so nice and answer any questions we have. My baby isn't the easiest but they always seem nice to him.

First time visiting, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience! I scheduled Jezebel’s appointment just yesterday, and today we were seen, treated, and had the bill taken care of all within under an hour.

Jezebel received the treatment she needed, along with medication to take home. The staff was incredibly friendly, patient, and made the entire visit easy and stress-free.

10/10 recommend! We will definitely be returning. 🐾💛
Everyone was so nice.   Thank you.

Both veterans I've at City Vet are amazing. Today I took my older dog in for ear infection. Didn't have an appointment but they took her right in. Can't tell you how much I appreciate everyone in their office. They are all very kind and helpful
Staff was very friendly. Kim was great!!
Always very happy with the care given to our pups by everyone at CityVet!

They do not properly take care of health records and they will tell you they have no records of someone’s dog having cancer because they have a new “system”. Absolutely ridiculous. They told my family member that they’re waiting for results for weeks for their dog and then said that their dog won’t make it through the night and to say their goodbyes even though she’s alive a week later. They also somehow “lost” the lab results and we have to get new ones. After all this money spent here it just becomes so regrettable. What is the point? They’re so disorganized and in my opinion have no idea what they’re doing. Sorry but it’s true.

I have been going to CityVet Bulverde for many years, and they have taken such wonderful care of both of my cats. Their compassion and dedication have meant so much to me over the years.

When I was going through end-of-life care with one of my cats, the CityVet team was incredibly caring, compassionate, and supportive throughout what was an extremely difficult decision. They treated both my cat and me with so much kindness and understanding.

Now, with my second elderly cat recently diagnosed with diabetes, I have once again been so impressed by the entire CityVet team. From the veterinarians and vet techs to the front desk staff, everyone has been kind, patient, knowledgeable, and supportive. They take the time to answer my questions and make sure I understand my cat’s care, which has given me complete confidence in the care he is receiving.

I am incredibly thankful for CityVet Bulverde. Knowing that my animals are in such capable and compassionate hands gives me so much peace of mind. They truly care about their patients and the people who love them, and I couldn’t be more grateful for everything they have done for my cats and for me.

Very disappointing experience. My dog had myasthenia gravis and depended on medication that this facility was responsible for refilling. It took nearly a month to receive the medication, and unfortunately, it was too late. I had to research the symptoms myself to understand how serious the situation was.

I strongly recommend that pet owners carefully follow up on medication refills and not assume they will be handled in a timely manner. I am extremely disappointed with the lack of urgency and communication.

My husband and I were so impressed with the care we received for Chester, our long haired, orange tabby cat. From the moment we called to schedule an appointment to the completion of our visit the next day, the doctor and staff were kind, detailed and very easy to work with.
Exceptional service as always!
Love this group!  Wouldn't take my animals anywhere else!
Great staff! I feel very confident in the care my sadie gets here.

River City Companion is a very professional, kind, and clean. The Veterinarian, Technicians, and admin staff treat us and our pets like their own family. RCCAH has been taking care of our pets since 2014. Couldn't ask for a better place to take my dogs for superb health care and treatment.

Very friendly staff and took great care of my kitties for their first check up & set of shots! Answered all of my questions and I didn’t feel like they were in a hurry to get on to next patient and didn’t have time for me.
Thank you, Doris, for taking the time to leave a review. We appreciate your feedback and look forward to serving you again.

My sweet Sophie recently passed away, and I didn't know what to do. I called, and they told me to bring her in, they would take care of it. In my grief, I forgot to save a lock of her fur. A few days later, they mailed me a piece of her hair and her little paw print. It meant more than words can say. Thank you for your kindness, compassion, and for taking such wonderful care of my sweet old girl.
great place for feral cat fix! Was over the limit on local spay & neuter, got recommended this place for the better was able to get in same day & pick up same day as well

Our husky suffered a medical emergency while we were out of town. The entire staff was so kind, compassionate, and took amazing care of our Zoey while making the difficult decision to let her pass over the rainbow bridge. Thank you guys for being there for her during her last moments

Recently moved to the area and needed to find a vet for my dog’s separation anxiety. Dr. Estes and the entire staff are 10/10. Everyone is so friendly and treated my fur baby exceptionally well. The receptionist went out of her way to help me with a prescription refill. CityVet will be our permanent vet from now on.

Everyone in this office is so very kind and empathetic. I called first thing Monday morning about my sick cat, and they immediately scheduled an appointment. From the front desk, the technician, and the Vet, everyone cared deeply about the situation, and I knew he was in good hands. They did all they could to help our poor little guy. I'm incredibly grateful to the entire staff.
Best vet in the area 10 out of 10 you should definitely take your pets there. They will take care of them as their own.  They really do work miracles there❤️
Thank you for your 5-star review!

CityVet is always wonderful with my animals.  Today they took care of one of my cats.  They are very thorough with any concerns I have, going over all the yearly vaccinations needed, and what is also recommended.  They also went over my cat’s weight and flea prevention.  I never feel rushed and the front staff and vet are always very kind.  I highly recommend CityVet.
Prompt service; thorough explanation of recommended treatment for Lady. Gentle handling of Lady! Lady returned happy & loving!
Love the veterinarian and the staff.
Thank you for your 5-star review!
everyone was super nice and everything went super quick!
First time here, and the front desk, technicians and doctor were very kind and attentive. We were able to book in same day and did not have to wait.

We received excellent veterinary care from Dr. Estes. Norma provided careful instruction on our dog’s at-home care with her patient demeanor. Dr. Estes called us with daily updates on our dog’s condition. We are extremely grateful for their support in supporting our dog’s recovery.
My dog just needed some vaccines and they performed a health check. The vet tech and vet were very friendly and seemed knowledge. I'll go back again.
Thank you for your 5-star review!

City Vet provides the kind of attentive, compassionate care every pet owner hopes for. The whole team works seamlessly together, and they’re incredibly responsive. I can call with a concern and often be seen within the hour. (And for no extra charge) The front desk staff were so kind and calming when I first called, which is what made me decide to give them a try. Dr. Belton and Dr. Estes are excellent, and the entire team gives thoughtful, personalized care to my very stubborn Shar-Pei. They even take my calls and follow up. I also appreciate that they’re thoughtful and fair with pricing and never push unnecessary services. I’m so grateful to have found such a caring and knowledgeable practice!!

Amazing staff!!
Caring ,compassionate and kind!
Everything a person could need for their pet babies in a vet!

I am extremely disappointed with CityVet. I brought my dog in for an ear infection this morning. Since he was stressed and tried to nip, the vet insisted on sedation for the exam. I signed an initial estimate of $160 for the exam and sedation.
The staff explicitly told me they would call me after the exam to discuss the treatment plan and costs before proceeding. That call never happened. When I arrived to pick up my dog, they had already performed the treatment and applied medication without my consent, bringing the bill to over $380.
This is unprofessional and a complete lack of transparency. You cannot perform unauthorized procedures and then demand more than double the agreed-upon price. I feel blindsided and taken advantage of. I will not be returning.
Fast, friendly and informative service!

I’ve been going to this vet’s office at this location and the previous location for almost 25 years and 95% of the time they are five star. Today they worked me in for an unexpected visit and it was quick, efficient and they have a very pleasant staff, as usual. Millie and Havoc both say thanks!
